title: Berry Overnight Oats
description: Creamy oats soaked in milk and topped with fresh berries, ready when you wake up.
steps: Stir the oats, milk, yoghurt and honey together in a jar.
Cover and chill overnight.
Loosen with a splash of milk if the oats are thick.
Top with berries and serve cold.

title: Garden Herb Omelette
description: A soft folded omelette with chives, parsley and a little cheese.
steps: Beat the eggs with the salt and herbs.
Melt the butter in a small pan over medium heat.
Pour in the eggs and stir gently until barely set.
Sprinkle over the cheese, fold in half and slide onto a plate.

title: Fluffy Banana Pancakes
description: Thick, tender pancakes with mashed banana stirred into the batter.
steps: Mash the bananas in a large bowl.
Whisk in the milk and egg, then fold in the flour and baking powder.
Heat a buttered pan and pour in small rounds of batter.
Cook until bubbles form, flip and cook until golden.
Stack and serve warm.

title: Lemony Chickpea Salad
description: A bright, crunchy salad of chickpeas, cucumber and tomato with a lemon dressing.
steps: Combine the chickpeas, cucumber, tomatoes and onion in a bowl.
Whisk the olive oil and lemon juice with a pinch of salt.
Toss the dressing through the salad.
Scatter with torn mint and serve.

title: Roasted Tomato Soup
description: A smooth soup made from oven-roasted tomatoes, garlic and basil.
steps: Roast the tomatoes and garlic with oil at 200C for 25 minutes.
Soften the onion in a pot.
Add the roasted tomatoes, garlic and stock and simmer for 10 minutes.
Blend until smooth with the basil.
Season and serve hot.

title: Crispy Chicken Wraps
description: Quick pan-fried chicken strips in a tortilla with crunchy lettuce and yoghurt sauce.
steps: Toss the chicken with the paprika and a pinch of salt.
Fry in hot oil for 8 minutes until cooked through.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan.
Fill with lettuce, chicken and a spoonful of yoghurt.
Roll up tightly and slice in half.

title: Mushroom Risotto
description: Slow-stirred rice with browned mushrooms, white wine and parmesan.
steps: Brown the mushrooms in butter and set them aside.
Soften the onion, then stir in the rice for one minute.
Add the wine and let it absorb.
Add stock a ladle at a time, stirring, for about 20 minutes.
Fold in the mushrooms and parmesan and rest for 2 minutes.

title: Red Lentil Curry
description: A warming dal of red lentils, tomato and spices served over rice.
steps: Fry the onion and curry powder for 3 minutes.
Add the lentils, tomatoes and 2 cups water.
Simmer for 20 minutes until the lentils collapse.
Stir in the coconut milk and heat through.
Serve over rice.

title: Lemon Baked Salmon
description: Oven-baked salmon fillets with lemon, dill and new potatoes.
steps: Halve the potatoes and roast them in oil for 10 minutes at 200C.
Lay the salmon among the potatoes with lemon slices on top.
Bake for 15 minutes until the fish flakes easily.
Scatter with dill and serve.

title: Fresh Pesto Pasta
description: Spaghetti tossed with basil pesto, cherry tomatoes and pine nuts.
steps: Boil the spaghetti in salted water until al dente.
Reserve a cup of the pasta water and drain.
Toss the pasta with pesto and a splash of the water.
Add the tomatoes and pine nuts and top with parmesan.

title: Ginger Veggie Stir-Fry
description: Crisp peppers, broccoli and carrots in a quick ginger and soy sauce.
steps: Heat the sesame oil in a wok until very hot.
Stir-fry the carrots and broccoli for 4 minutes.
Add the pepper and ginger and cook for 2 minutes.
Pour in the soy sauce and toss for 1 minute.
Serve straight away.

title: Warm Apple Crumble
description: Spiced baked apples under a buttery oat crumble topping.
steps: Toss the apples with the cinnamon in a baking dish.
Rub the butter into the flour, oats and sugar until crumbly.
Spread the crumble evenly over the apples.
Bake at 180C for 40 minutes until golden.
Rest for 10 minutes before serving.

title: Dark Chocolate Mousse
description: A light, airy mousse of dark chocolate and whipped cream.
steps: Melt the chocolate gently and let it cool slightly.
Stir in the egg yolks.
Whip the cream to soft peaks and fold it in.
Whisk the whites with the sugar and fold them in.
Chill for at least 2 hours before serving.

title: Coconut Rice Pudding
description: Creamy stovetop rice pudding made with coconut milk and vanilla.
steps: Combine the rice, coconut milk and oat milk in a pot.
Simmer on low for 30 minutes, stirring often.
Stir in the maple syrup and vanilla.
Serve warm or chilled.
